title: ABACUS: Program-Guided Multistep Reasoning over Frozen Judgment Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.25963v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Judgment models answer semantic questions by scoring a finite set of candidate outcomes. Can reusable programs turn these local decisions into powerful multistep reasoning? We introduce \method, a framework that jointly constructs judgment schemas and composition programs for frozen judgment models. A generative teacher designs the procedure offline; the judgment model resolves local semantic questions online, and the saved program composes its decisions into an answer. We study three allocations of design effort between humans and the teacher, focusing on construction through a shared interface. We instantiate the framework with Kev. On three selected BIG-Bench Hard tasks, nine independently constructed programs solve all 450 executions of 150 development inputs. translated_title: ABACUS：基于程序引导的冻结判断模型多步推理
translated_abstract: 判断模型通过对有限候选结果进行评分来回答语义问题。可复用的程序能否将这些局部决策转化为强大的多步推理？我们提出了ABACUS，一个为冻结判断模型联合构建判断模式与组合程序的框架。生成式教师离线设计程序流程；判断模型在线解决局部语义问题，而保存下来的程序将其决策组合成最终答案。我们研究了人类与教师之间设计工作的三种分配方式，重点关注通过共享接口进行程序构建。我们使用Kev对该框架进行了实例化。在三个选定的BIG-Bench Hard任务上，九个独立构建的程序解决了150个开发输入的全部450次执行。在另一项独立的部署研究中，三个程序在经过开发集参考一致性优化后被冻结，并在600个保留问题上进行评估。这些程序达到了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ABACUS框架通过生成式教师离线构建判断模式与组合程序，将冻结判断模型的局部语义评分决策组合成强大的多步推理，无需微调模型即可在BIG-Bench Hard等任务上取得优异表现。
